item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Sep 09
item.description:
21 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Refrigeration status now updates instantly when items are moved, fixing the previous delay.
  • Stags now correctly respond to AI select and move commands, restoring expected livestock handling.

Base & Crafting

  • Refrigeration status now updates instantly when items are moved, fixing the previous delay.

Vendors

  • A vendor NPC has been added to the Ranch, allowing players to purchase items there.

Animals & Tools

  • Animal leads now work correctly after purchase, letting you tether animals as intended.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Stags now correctly respond to AI select and move commands, restoring expected livestock handling.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a crash when opening the vehicle editing panel, preventing unexpected game exits.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Sep 08
item.description:
73 development commits

Animals & NPCs

  • NPCs can now sell baby animals to players
  • Livestock can now drink water from troughs with integrated water container
  • Frogs can swim and more reliably locate water spots for croaking
  • Fixed livestock pathfinding in short corridors, preventing premature path completion

Structures & Defenses

  • Sandbag pillbox barricade deployable added, with new sandbag variations and its own crafting and repair setup
  • Smart alarm can now be placed on top of more deployables and has corrected bounds
  • Gate improvements: reversed open direction, better volume snapping, updated collision bounds, fixed socket checks, and wood‑based debris protection for durability

Crafting & Cooking

  • Cooking workbench no longer stops in snow when refrigerated items are inserted, preserving the refrigerated flag on split stacks
  • Placeholder crafting costs adjusted to more sensible values

Power & Loot Rooms

  • Ferry terminal loot room now functional with its own power grid

Server Stability

  • Fixed server stall caused by dtRaycast infinite loop and updated navigation version to avoid degenerate polygon saves

Medical Items

  • Honey bandage added to both primitive and hardcore tech trees

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Sep 07
item.description:
38 development commits

Animals & Livestock

  • Cows now have health tied to mood; unhappy cows die and health bar reflects condition.
  • Calf spawning fixed so newborn calves no longer get stuck behind walls and can escape pens.

Weapons & Attachments

  • Holosight rail visibility adjusted per weapon and 8x scope, handmade sight, and holosight attachments refreshed.
  • Holstered weapons repositioned to sit closer to chest armor for better alignment.

Building & UI

  • Placement guide rotations fixed, improving accuracy when rotating structures during building.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Train tunnel layouts are now randomized, changing navigation routes and loot placement in underground networks.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a save bug that unintentionally altered the Most Recently Used (MRU) list, preventing unexpected inventory changes on logout.
